title: Epidemiologic Study and Impact Study of a Dialysis Solution Change on the Electrocardiographic Profile of Patient
brief_summary: Epidemiologic Study and Impact Study of a Dialysis Solution Change on the Electrocardiographic Profile of Patient
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>18
* patient under haemodialysis treatment
* patient not objecting to study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with known cardiac arrythmias
study_population: Haemodialysed patients from two nephrology centers.
